column2: A shallow wooden bowl holds round beige chickpeas, with several loose chickpeas and one split pod beside it.
A startled cashier raises both hands while a masked robber gestures toward an open money drawer; show no injury.
A honeycomb drips golden honey onto a spoon held above a small open pot.
A wooden artist's mannequin bends at clearly visible shoulder, elbow, hip and knee joints on a worktable.
A long-legged dog lopes easily across grass, with relaxed extended strides and its owner jogging behind.
A low line of boundary stones separates a cultivated field from a neighboring meadow, with a gate at one end.
A compact electric motor has a cylindrical housing, projecting drive shaft, mounting feet and two attached power wires.
Two children gather fallen nuts into a wicker basket beneath a leafy walnut tree.
A black-and-white magpie perches on a branch, displaying its long tail and contrasting white shoulder patches.
A boastful child points dismissively at a classmate's painting while the classmate lowers the picture and looks hurt.
A baseball fielder touches the base while securely holding the ball just before the approaching runner arrives.
Two friends finish exchanging matching sets of marbles and shake hands, each holding an equal collection.
A potter presses a collapsed clay bowl back into a fresh rounded bowl on the same pottery wheel.
A carpenter redraws a clear cutting mark on a wooden board after rubbing away the misplaced original mark.
A child hands a carefully rewrapped present back to the smiling friend who now reaches out to receive it.
A server brings another portion of soup to a diner whose empty bowl is held out over the table.
An exceptionally skilled young violinist performs confidently at a school concert while the audience listens with delighted attention.
A witness raises one hand solemnly and places the other on a plain closed book before an official desk.
Thirty identical beads form five orderly rows of six on one counting board, with only the final bead highlighted gold.
A metalworker brushes a thin bright coating of molten tin over a dull copper pan on the workbench.
An accountant revises a damaged van's value in an asset ledger, crossing out a tall coin-stack pictogram and drawing a shorter one.
A painter rolls fresh blue paint across an entire wall, reaching the edges while only one small unpainted patch remains.
A rolled papal document lies partly open beside a heavy lead seal suspended from its cord; use no readable writing.
A worker gathers several slender sticks together and tightly ties them into one compact bundle with twine.
A student hands back a school identification card and leaves the classroom carrying a packed bag while a teacher watches sadly.
Fifty small wooden counters fill five rows of ten, with the last counter distinctively red and the preceding forty-nine uncolored.
Friends sit casually around a low table, sharing fruit and drinks in a comfortable living room.
A supervisor gives a clear approving thumbs-up to a worker poised to begin painting a wall with a roller.
A grandmother helps her young granddaughter bake small cookies at a shared kitchen counter.
A determined worker holds a heavy door closed while a crowd outside presses against it.
A person sews a cloth bag by hand at home, with fabric scraps, thread and an almost finished bag on the table.
A spoon lifts a wobbly translucent mound of fruit jelly from a glass bowl, with the jelly holding its soft shape.
A balance scale holds a weight engraved only “1 kg” on one pan and a bag of flour balanced on the other.
A mechanical counting device displays “1000” in four numeral windows beside a collection box filled with small wooden beads.
A tired gardener lies down on a bench beneath a tree, boots resting on the ground and a hat over the face.
The cut edge of a plywood sheet reveals several thin layers bonded together, with one corner gently lifted for clarity.
A painter expresses joy through a bright swirling canvas while painting with an animated face and open, sweeping gestures.
A person signs a replacement form beside an earlier sheet with a clearly crossed-out signature area; keep writing indistinct.
A child sorts a mixed button collection again, moving one misplaced red button into the red group in a divided tray.
A run-down mechanical clock has stopped, with its hands motionless and the winding key resting unused beside it.
A scout crouches behind a bush and studies a distant campsite through binoculars before moving closer.
A dismissive critic scoffs at a student's proposal, waving one hand aside while the student holds a simple model.
A show-off balances several plates unnecessarily high at a picnic while the other guests look on with uneasy surprise.
Sixty small shells fill six rows of ten in one tray, with only the final shell outlined by a plain colored ring.
A person ties running shoes while holding up the now-loose waistband of exercise trousers, with a gym bag beside the bench.
A tipped jug spills water across a table edge, and a surprised child reaches for a cloth.
A pair of speakers stands on opposite sides of a listener, who sits centrally facing a record player.
An animal trainer calmly guides a large horse around a training ring using a long lead rope.
A contractor submits a sealed tender envelope across a desk beside a detailed model of the proposed building.
A traveler happily opens a newly delivered letter at a small table, with its envelope and a family photograph nearby.
A bus-station timetable displays a column of small clock faces aligned with bus pictograms, with a traveler consulting it.
A growing crescent moon hangs above a quiet rooftop, with its brightly illuminated curved portion clearly visible.
A duck lifts one foot above shallow water, clearly spreading the webbing between its toes.
A witch enchants a small broom that rises gently from the floor while her hand guides it.
A mature apple tree bears abundant ripe apples, with laden branches bending above full baskets on the ground.
A patient adult helps a nervous puppy become accustomed to a collar, offering a treat while gently fastening it.
A small congregation bows their heads together at the close of a prayer, with hands joined and peaceful expressions.
Penguins gather beside Antarctic sea ice, with a low glacier and a dark cold sea behind them.
A round-bellied cooking pot bulges outward beneath its narrow opening, shown beside a folded cloth on a table.
A news editor enthusiastically presents a newly printed front page with a large central photograph, keeping all lettering unreadable.
A newly qualified driver holds an official-looking certificate beside a driving instructor and a parked training car.
A cutaway nautilus shell reveals a spiral sequence of clearly separated internal chambers within the single shell.
Townspeople cooperatively build a public well, a paved path and a small school around their shared square, without contrasting peoples or cultures.
A wet kitten clings tightly to a rescue worker's sleeve with both forepaws as the worker lifts it safely.
A stack of unstable crates has come down in a tumble, with a startled worker looking at the scattered contents.
A student studies an open book closely beneath a desk lamp, following a line with one finger and taking careful notes.
A ship's officer directs the helmsman from the bridge, pointing toward a safe gap between two distant buoys.
Two children work together to lift one heavy basket, each gripping a handle on the same side of the path.
A bright lamp dazzles a person, who shields the eyes with one hand and turns the face away.
A distant cottage sits across a wide valley, appearing tiny beyond several nearer hills and a long winding path.
A farmhouse stands beside a vegetable plot, a small barn and a fence enclosing a few grazing sheep.
A street-cleaning worker directs a strong hose stream along a gutter, flushing mud toward the open drain.
A quick goalkeeper foils a close shot by catching the ball firmly before it can enter the net.
Forty pebbles form four neat rows of ten, with the fortieth pebble alone painted blue at the end.
A guilty child quietly slips away from a broken window while another child is left holding the stray football.
A hired farm laborer carries a heavy feed sack from a barn toward a waiting farmer and livestock trough.
Historical naval officers forcibly lead an unwilling civilian away from a dockside crowd toward a waiting ship.
An intruder climbs through an open garden window while the startled householder discovers the unexpected entry.
A forged iron gate has thick dark bars, a strong latch and rough hammered hinges attached to stone posts.
A jaguar stands beside tropical foliage, showing a muscular body, broad head and black rosette markings on golden fur.
People form a single orderly line outside a small food stall, each waiting behind the next person.
A careless walker drops an empty snack wrapper onto a clean path instead of using the nearby bin.
A shopkeeper replaces a tall coin-stack price pictogram with a smaller stack beside a winter coat on display.
Two travelers discover they have exchanged suitcases by mistake, opening matching cases that contain unfamiliar clothes.
A gardener pushes a mower across tall grass, leaving a freshly cut strip directly behind the machine.
Ninety small counters fill nine rows of ten on one board, with the last counter distinctly purple.
A sturdy brass padlock hangs closed through the hasp of a wooden shed door, with its curved shackle visible.
A speaker presents a strong practical argument by showing a model bridge safely holding a heavy weight to an attentive audience.
A tawny puma stands on a rocky ledge, with a long curved tail and rounded ears clearly visible.
A worker lifts loose paving stones and lays them again in a straight, tightly fitted section of path.
Two workers pull a slack rope tight again around a bundle of timber, leaning backward together.
A creeping plant sends low stems along the soil, rooting at several nodes beneath a line of fresh leaves.
A gardener shakes soil through a broad coarse-mesh riddle while larger stones remain on its wooden frame.
A schoolteacher kneels beside a student's desk and patiently guides the child through an illustrated exercise.
Seventy small wooden disks fill seven rows of ten, with the seventieth disk highlighted orange at the row's end.
A plumber turns a shut-off valve until water stops flowing from the adjacent tap into a waiting bucket.
A newcomer joins a community club by handing a completed picture-only membership form to the welcoming organizer.
A family shares a sit-down meal around a fully set table, with everyone seated comfortably in chairs.
A diner gives a flat, uncertain hand gesture after tasting an ordinary sandwich, with a neutral expression.
A traveler rests with a suitcase between connecting flights, watching parked planes through an airport lounge window.
A streetcar travels along rails embedded in a city street beneath overhead power wires, with passengers visible inside.
A plain blue sweatshirt hangs from a wooden hanger, showing soft cuffs, a crew neck and a ribbed waistband.
A large tablespoon rests beside a soup bowl, its broad deep oval bowl catching the light.
A leather worker stretches a cleaned hide over a frame beside a vat used for tanning.
A small handleless teacup filled with steaming green tea stands on a simple wooden tray.
A squat teapot has a curved spout, fitted lid, arched handle and gentle steam rising from its opening.
A small teaspoon rests on a saucer beside a teacup, with a few loose tea leaves nearby.
Two soccer teammates exchange a supportive high-five beside the same goal while wearing matching plain jerseys.
A sturdy striped mattress tick lies partly open, revealing soft filling enclosed by the protective fabric cover.
A girl suddenly notices her missing mitten beneath a chair, widening her eyes and pointing toward it.
A fishing float bobs up and down on small waves beside a seated angler holding the line.
A violinist draws a bow across the strings of a wooden violin, with the instrument resting beneath the chin.
A sleeping child begins to waken, opening the eyes and lifting the head as morning light reaches the pillow.
A handler rests one hand on the raised withers between a horse's neck and back, marking the exact shoulder ridge without text.
Two married women stand beside their respective spouses at a shared picnic, with simple wedding bands visible on their hands.
A child suddenly solves a wooden puzzle and raises one finger with a delighted expression of recognition.
A maple branch carries opposite lobed leaves and paired winged seeds, with one seed pair falling nearby.
A repairer suddenly spots a loose wire inside a lamp, lifting the eyebrows and pointing to the connection.
An alto singer performs in a small choir, holding a plain music folder and singing with a relaxed low register posture.
A large ampersand symbol “&” is drawn clearly in dark ink on a single cream card beside a fountain pen.
A freshwater angelfish swims among aquatic plants, displaying a tall triangular body and long trailing fins.
An anteater lowers its long narrow snout toward an ant mound, with its bushy tail and strong foreclaws visible.
A round ceramic ashtray has three cigarette rests around the rim and a small amount of gray ash inside.
A concealed attacker aims a crossbow toward a crowned ruler on a balcony while guards face away; show no wounds or gore.
A noisy child babbles animatedly with a wide-open mouth and restless hands while nearby listeners look overwhelmed.
A complicated tangle of cords baffles a repairer, who holds two mismatched plugs and scratches the head.
A rug-cleaning worker strikes a hanging carpet with a woven beater, releasing a visible puff of dust.
A soft-bodied blimp floats above rooftops, showing its rounded envelope, small gondola and stabilizing tail fins.
A pair of bongo drums stands close together, with one hand striking the smaller taut drumhead.
A cheerful group of friends shares a relaxed outdoor meal, laughing together around a simple picnic table.
A cricket bowler releases a ball toward the batter with one arm fully extended in an overarm delivery.
A broadcasting station has a compact studio building, a tall transmission mast and an illuminated recording room window.
A thick chocolate brownie square rests on a plate, with a moist cut surface and a few scattered crumbs.
A bully snatches a smaller child's school bag while two classmates look concerned and move to help.
A bureaucrat checks a thick folder at an office desk, carefully stamping one form before placing it in an orderly tray.
A practical craft worker makes a sturdy plain wooden box with carefully arranged tools and an economical straight-edged design.
A steep-sided isolated butte rises above a flat dry plain, with a small shrub near its base for scale.
A campground contains three pitched tents around a shared fire ring, with a water pump and backpacks nearby.
A small group sings a Christmas carol beside a decorated evergreen tree, holding plain song folders without readable lyrics.
A reflective CD-ROM rests halfway inside an open computer optical-drive tray, with a clear central hole and no printed label.
A chairperson leads a meeting from the head of a table, inviting one participant to speak while the others listen.
A person checks off square boxes beside simple packing-item pictures on a clipboard while arranging the matching objects in a bag.
A small songbird chirps from a branch with its beak open and throat lifted, while another bird listens nearby.
A cloakroom attendant accepts a visitor's coat across a counter, with bags and coats neatly stored behind.
A thick stick clogs a bicycle wheel between the spokes and frame, stopping the rider beside a muddy path.
